label: Soft Shadow Panel
author: Conky-Studio
description: Filled rounded panel with multi-pass drop shadow for depth. Pair with Glass Panel for layered UI cards.
lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h, rad = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}, {corner_radius}
 local function rr(ox, oy, alpha, expand)
  local rr_ = math.min(rad + expand * 0.3, (w + expand)/2, (h + expand)/2)
  local xx, yy, ww, hh = x - expand/2 + ox, y - expand/2 + oy, w + expand, h + expand
  cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
  if rr_ > 0 then
   cairo_arc(cr, xx+ww-rr_, yy+rr_, rr_, -math.pi/2, 0)
   cairo_arc(cr, xx+ww-rr_, yy+hh-rr_, rr_, 0, math.pi/2)
   cairo_arc(cr, xx+rr_, yy+hh-rr_, rr_, math.pi/2, math.pi)
   cairo_arc(cr, xx+rr_, yy+rr_, rr_, math.pi, 3*math.pi/2)
  else
   cairo_rectangle(cr, xx, yy, ww, hh)
  end
  cairo_close_path(cr)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 0, 0, 0, alpha)
  cairo_fill(cr)
 end
 local sp = {shadow_spread}
 local so = {shadow_opacity}
 if sp > 0 and so > 0 then
  for i = 3, 1, -1 do
   rr(0, {shadow_offset_y}, so * (i / 6), sp * (i / 3))
  end
 end
 local r, g, b = {color}
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 if rad > 0 then
  local rr_ = math.min(rad, w/2, h/2)
  cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+w-rr_, y+rr_, rr_, -math.pi/2, 0)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+w-rr_, y+h-rr_, rr_, 0, math.pi/2)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+rr_, y+h-rr_, rr_, math.pi/2, math.pi)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+rr_, y+rr_, rr_, math.pi, 3*math.pi/2)
  cairo_close_path(cr)
 else
  cairo_rectangle(cr, x, y, w, h)
 end
 cairo_fill(cr)
